title: Swap Lifecycle Event Envelope
description: Common envelope shared by all swap lifecycle events (schema version 1). Every published swap event payload MUST validate against this envelope. Event-specific payloads extend this envelope via allOf in their respective schema files.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance. MUST be stable across retries and replays of the same logical event.

event_type.description: Discriminator identifying which swap lifecycle event this payload represents.

schema_version.description: Major schema version of the event contract. Consumers MUST reject payloads whose major version they do not support. Additive changes do not bump this value; breaking changes introduce a new major version directory (e.g. v2) published alongside the old one.

occurred_at.description: Canonical timestamp of when the lifecycle transition occurred, in UTC, formatted as RFC 3339 with a 'Z' suffix and at least millisecond precision. Local timezones and offsets other than 'Z' are not permitted.

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns the order. Shared contracts MUST NOT carry tenant-specific fields beyond this identifier.

order_id.description: Identifier of the swap order this event pertains to.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier tying together all events for a single logical operation (e.g. a request or workflow).

trace_id.description: Optional distributed tracing identifier (e.g. W3C traceparent trace-id) for cross-service observability.

sequence.description: Optional monotonically increasing sequence number per order, used by consumers to detect out-of-order delivery.

producer.description: Optional identifier of the producing service or component.

amount.description: Canonical decimal amount encoded as a string (never a JSON number) to avoid floating-point precision loss, consistent with the decimal policy. Optional leading '-', integer part, optional fractional part; no exponent notation, no thousands separators, no leading '+'.

asset.description: Asset identifier (e.g. ticker or canonical asset code).

timestamp.description: Canonical UTC timestamp, RFC 3339 with 'Z' suffix and at least millisecond precision.

status.description: Lifecycle status of a swap order. New statuses may be added in a future minor revision; consumers MUST treat unknown statuses as non-terminal and forward-compatible.
